title: NATS request/reply studio.see (pipelines → studio)
description: From API 1.65 (contracts/README.md, Assistant: media and vision). Core NATS request/reply on subject `studio.see` (queue group `studio`), bare JSON: the pictures of one take for the assistant's own model when it sees images (cmd.assistant.turn settings.sees). Asked as the thread's owner: owner_id must own thread_id and the take (else not_found). Studio reads the take's thumbnail (an image's, a video's poster; else the image itself; from API 1.104 a video's frame grid once its facts are made) and answers it as JPEG, its long side at most 1024 px; an audio take has no pictures. From 1.104 a video or audio take's `facts` (Take facts) come too. Never stored, never on a stream: the bytes go only into the model call. Studio answers within 5 s.

images.description: JPEG pictures, base64: an image's one, a video's poster (from API 1.104 its frame grid, each frame's time printed on it, once made), none for audio

facts.description: from API 1.104: a video or audio take's facts (Take facts); null or absent until made, and for an image

at.description: from API 1.104: the seconds of the grid's frames, in order (a video whose grid is the picture)
